title: Overall help regarding Traps and environmental hazards

posts.author: Nevercry02
posts.body:
Ive been trying to do a little dungeon crawler as a starting project, and as a dungeon I want to fill it with traps and environmental hazards, Arrows, saw blades, pits etc.
Tried making a shooting arrow event by making it damage on contact but havent managed it to loop around.
Im fairly new to RPGM so this might be a dumb question, sorry lol

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
I just did a quick internet search for "RPG Maker MZ Arrow Trap" and I found a number of older forum posts and YouTube videos that might help you.
You could also search for something like "RPG Maker MZ Projectiles".
I am pretty sure those two searches will yield something that will help you learn how to do this.
If not, you would probably have to clarify exactly what you have managed to achieve so far and what isn't working correctly, along with screenshots of your events.
Good luck!
